I’m Annie, and I absolutely LOVE animals!

Every weekend I volunteer at Hilbrae Animal Rescue Centre in Telford, Shropshire, helping dogs, cats and all sorts of furry friends find their forever homes.


On this channel you’ll see:


🐶 Rescue stories

🐱 Cute animal moments

🎓 Training tips

🏡 Behind-the-scenes life at a rescue shelter

❤️ Happy adoption updates



Animals mean the world to me, and I want to share their stories with YOU.



If you love animals as much as I do — hit subscribe and join the pack! 🐾💕
